telemetry_name: Formula Classic Gen3 Model4 - High Downforce
confidence_notes: Guided testing directly established the gear count, the standing-start clutch, the clutchless running shifts, and the automatic cut and blip state.
scope_notes: Single exact identity staged from one guided-verification drive.

additional_telemetry_names.basis: Base configuration of the same car. This exact string was not observed: it is derived from the car's observed high-downforce identity by removing the suffix, which the class confirms. Another car in F-Classic_Gen3 was loaded in all of its packages and the same derivation reproduces its observed names exactly, as it does for every one of the fifteen cars where both forms were seen. AMS2 selects the aero configuration from the circuit, so a driver reaches this identity without choosing it. Controls are inherited from the driven high-downforce configuration and were not separately tested. If the derivation is wrong the identity simply never matches, which is what a driver sees today.
